question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Newspaper gives us news of home and abroad. It has useful to all sections of people. They are great educative value too. present really part and parcel of our life. us the outside world like a mirror.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Newspapers are really a part and parcel of our life. (b) It gives us news of home and abroad. (c) They are useful to all section of people. (d) They present us the outside world like a mirror. (e) It has great educative value too.
